display.purpose: Fast page orientation and high-priority decisions.

body.purpose: Compact, readable roster and strategy copy.

shadows.name: surface-low
shadows.purpose: Quietly separate cards from the mineral canvas.

shadows.name: surface-raised
shadows.purpose: Raise the primary recommendation and interactive overlays.

motion.name: control-response
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, active, and tactile control feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapse transitions for users who request less motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Teal action for the next player decision.
components.css: .ds-primary { background:#087F78; color:#FFFDF8; border-radius:8px; padding:.65rem .9rem; font:750 .84rem system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #087F78; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Manager Card
components.description: Dense roster comparison surface with rarity coding and verified progression facts.
components.css: .ds-manager-card { background:#FFFDF8; color:#1D2230; border:1px solid #DDDCD3; border-radius:18px; padding:1.25rem; box-shadow:0 2px 3px rgba(38,29,56,.07); }

components.name: Recommendation Card
components.description: Deep plum priority surface with an amber next-move rail and evidence-backed action.
components.html:
RECOMMENDATION

Rank up your manager

Verified roster evidence appears here.
components.css: .ds-recommendation { background:#201A35; color:#FAF8F0; border:1px solid #30264C; border-radius:18px; padding:1.5rem; } .ds-recommendation span { color:#FFC267; font-size:.65rem; letter-spacing:.12em; font-weight:750; }

components.name: Roster Spotlight
components.description: Portrait-led area summary derived from the strongest owned manager in each covered department.
components.css: .ds-leader-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:44px 105px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:58px; padding:0 .7rem; border:1px solid #DDDCD3; border-radius:8px; background:#F7F4EC; }

components.name: Desktop Rail
components.description: Persistent desktop navigation that becomes a phone bottom bar.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:.45rem; padding:.6rem .7rem; background:#201A35; } .ds-nav button { border-radius:8px; padding:.7rem; background:transparent; color:#A59DBD; } .ds-nav button[aria-current=page] { color:#4BD7BF; background:#30264C; }

narrative.overview: MineOps is a personal desktop game board: part roster wall, part upgrade notebook, and part next-move compass. It uses a warm mineral-paper workspace, a deep plum shell, rarity-led manager cards, and meaningful status accents so the next decision is obvious without becoming a generic admin dashboard.

rules.name: The Decision-First Rule
rules.body: Lead each view with the next useful player decision, then expose supporting evidence.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal means go or trust; amber means inspect or prioritize; red means recover.

rules.name: The Density-with-Order Rule
rules.body: Desktop may be information-dense, but each surface needs one clear reading path.

dos: Do lead with the player's next decision.
Do make the desktop roster scannable in seconds.
Do keep real data and uncertainty visible.
Do preserve keyboard focus and the mobile adaptation.
donts: Don't return to dark-only phone-first styling as the default.
Don't make every calculator equally prominent.
Don't use decorative icons or color without meaning.
Don't invent game values or progression state.
